auth.loginSubtitle: Akaunti imodzi ya Nyumba, SendUs, ndi ntchito zina zadigital za Malawi.
auth.registerSubtitle: Lowani kuti mupeze Nyumba, SendUs, ndi ma modulu ena omwe akubwera.
auth.backendHint: Backend iyenera kukhala pa <0>/api</0> (wonani <1>vite.config.ts</1>). Ikani <2>VITE_API_BASE_URL</2> pa production.

errors.signInFailed: Kulowa kwalephera. Onani URL ya API ndi kuti server ikugwira.

dashboard.subtitle: Malo amodzi a ntchito zadigital za Malawi — kulowa kamodzi, ntchito zonse.
dashboard.blurbRich: Kuchoka kupanga kukodetsa kwa <0>265Nyumba</0> kupita ku ntchito za <1>SendUs</1>, zonse zili pamenepa.
dashboard.modulesIntro: Sankhani ntchito kuti mutsegule malo ake. Zotsekedwa zikubwera posacedwa kwa mabungwe ndi ogwiritsa oyamba.

nyumba.name: 265Nyumba
nyumba.tagline: Kukodetsa popanda malipiro a ma agent
nyumba.description: Alandlord amasindikiza manyumba; akukodetsa amasaka mizinda, mtengo, ndi zipinda—ndiponso kulumikizana mwini wake. Zapangidwa kuchepetsa vuto la “half rent kwa ma agent” mu Malawi.

sendus.name: SendUs
sendus.description: Pezani zovala, kutenga mapharcela, kulipira mabili, kuyimirira layini, kapena kuthandizira ndi ma document. Othandizira amasankha ntchito monga “Uber ya ntchito zochepa”.

courier.name: 265Courier
courier.description: Bookani Blantyre ↔ Lilongwe (and beyond) ndi kutsatira ndi mitengo yovomerezeka kwa othumiza ndi odziwa.

market.name: 265Market
market.description: Zamagetsi, mipando, foni, ndi magalimoto—mawonekedwe pakati pa anthu ndi macheza otetezeka kuposa mafeso a Facebook.

services.name: 265Services
services.description: Mapayipi, magetsi, oyamba, akunyamula—ikani ntchito, linganizani, ndiponso kumanga othandizira oyambirira pafupi.

jobs.name: 265Jobs
jobs.description: Kuthandizira m'makono, kusasa, chitetezo, ntchito yochepa—mabwenzi ndi ogwira ntchito yosalemera.

property-mgmt.name: 265Property Management
property-mgmt.description: Rent rolls, zolemb za akukodetsa, zidziwitso, zovuta, ndi mawonekedwe oyambirira—pambuyo pa Nyumba, kuti muthandize ofunika.

payments.name: 265Payments
payments.description: Ndola ya foni ndi mabanki m'ma module: escrow ya SendUs, malipiro za Nyumba, ndi kupereka kwa othandizira.

ride.name: 265Ride
ride.description: Mayendedwe a njinga kapena magalimoto mu Blantyre / Lilongwe—mothandizika ndi chikhulupiriro ndi malipiro pa platform.

launchpad.name: Module launchpad
launchpad.description: Malo oyimirira zotsatira (monga agritech, nyumba za ophunzira, kapena logistics). Sinthani ndi ma modulu oyambirira.
